objective: Resolve the exact canonical Kummer quotient orientation and equality-only coverage boundary with one zero-run theorem packet, exact snapshot, three mutually blind max-tier reviews, and neutral ledger disposition.

candidates.title: Canonical Kummer quotient orientation-and-coverage theorem
candidates.uncertainty: Whether the concrete width-two quotient graph has the claimed endpoint structure, forbids a memoryless source-consistent +P selector, admits only an oriented faithful lift, and limits target-independent equality-only occurrence replay to 2MK targets.
candidates.positive_decision: Archive only the exact scoped theorem if every clause survives review; rerank away from canonical equality-only occurrence lists while leaving adaptive coordinate-reading and high-branching algebraic routers open.
candidates.negative_decision: Record the exact counterexample or duplicate clause and reject only the frozen theorem statement; do not infer a Kummer-lane or ECDLP lower bound.
candidates.inconclusive_decision: Return REVISE/select-none with the first undefined endpoint, quantifier, decoder, coverage, or retry obligation; absence is not evidence.
candidates.next_action: Produce one zero-run packet under TASK-20260823-b66c61, snapshot it, run three disjoint reviews, and ledger-dispose.

ambiguities.question: Is the Kummer deck itself new?
ambiguities.resolution: No. IDEA-057, IDEA-158, IDEA-195, and BATCH-026 already cover trace/norm, orientation, non-Cartesian routing objectives, and neighborhood decks. Only the exact graph/locator/decoder/coverage composition may add scoped content.
ambiguities.basis: Committed semantic audit summarized in the B62 Coordinator rerank.

ambiguities.question: Would a passed coverage theorem lower-bound ECDLP?
ambiguities.resolution: No. It applies only to target-independent equality-only pre-hit occurrence-offset replay and refuses adaptive field-coordinate or nonlinear aggregate algorithms.

candidates.dominated_by: Pollard rho/BSGS at exponent 1/2 for the frozen equality-only single-target architecture; no realized B62 algorithm exists.

sota_delta.note: The intended exact boundary reaches exponent 1/2 and creates no algorithmic frontier point.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: Exact proofs or counterexamples for the quotient graph, locator, lift, decoder, coverage set, and nested-retry accounting under frozen quantifiers.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: No implementation or execution; identify the cheapest missing proof obligation.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any hidden orientation bit, target-dependent pre-hit schedule, coordinate-reading step, omitted endpoint multiplicity, duplicate clause presented as new, or unknown axis used as domination forces REVISE.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: All three independent reviews and the Coordinator ledger disposition are durably archived.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Static finite-group proof, symbolic enumeration, semantic audit, blind cost rederivation, adversarial review, and archival.

resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One producer, one snapshot, three parallel mutually blind reviews, one ledger archive.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after one complete packet and three terminal reviews; stop any positive interpretation on a failed clause or scope overreach.

claims.statement: The canonical odd-prime Kummer quotient has the stated path multigraph; quotient-only memoryless +P selection is impossible; oriented history lifts faithfully; and a target-independent equality-only occurrence-list collision architecture covers at most 2MK targets before retries.
